method.mechanism: Agent hypothesis. In each block, multiply the second convolution's post-activation residual output by sigmoid(W LayerNorm(x) + b), then add the original residual. Initialize W and b to zero, giving a 0.5 multiplier initially. The generated control uses the same per-block linear gate and initialization but feeds it an all-ones tensor, producing an input-independent learned channel multiplier. This isolates state dependence from adding a gate and changing initial residual scale.
